displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E18
meaning: Control does not see its own send message: the integrated furnace control is not seeing the blower-communication send.
causes: The control's own blower-communication send path has failed
Harness or wiring, if the code changes to E17 when the 4-pin connector is removed
diySteps: Do not unplug the blower harness with the power on. The chart's test is done with power on, inside a live cabinet
Technician: with power on, remove the 4-pin motor connector from the IFC. If the code changes to E17, verify the harness and wiring. If it does not change, replace the IFC
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E18 is the control not seeing its own send message. E17 is the control not seeing the motor's reply.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
